items.label: Include
items.content:
# Including the AIClient Library

To use AIClient in the browser, include this script in your HTML:

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>
```

**What Happens:**
- AIClient becomes globally available.
- No module bundlers are required.

**Step Visualization:**
![Include Script](https://via.placeholder.com/400x200?text=Include+Script)

This is the first step to get started.

items.label: API Key
items.content:
# Setting Your API Key

You must authenticate with your key:

```javascript
client.setApiKey('YOUR_API_KEY');
```

**Step Visualization:**
![API Key](https://via.placeholder.com/400x200?text=Set+API+Key)

items.label: Model
items.content:
# Selecting a Model

Choose a text or image model for generation:

```javascript
client.setModel('flux'); // default is 'flux'
```

Check official pages for supported models:
- [Pollinations Models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
- [Model Health](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai/)

**Step Visualization:**
![Model Selection](https://via.placeholder.com/400x200?text=Select+Model)

items.label: Type
items.content:
# Choosing Type

Decide if you want **text** or **image** output:

```javascript
client.setType('text'); // 'text' or 'image'
```

**Step Visualization:**
![Select Type](https://via.placeholder.com/400x200?text=Select+Type)
